description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 维护的本地插件集合：版本、说明与安装方式。
description.en: Local plugins for DeepSeek Harness: versions, notes and install steps.

plugins.name: dsh-chat-clock

description.zh: 让 DSH 聊天里的消息时间戳不再依赖鼠标悬停，旧消息也能一眼看到发送时间。
description.en: Keep message timestamps always visible in the DSH chat, including older messages.

plugins.install:
git clone git@github.com:martinx/dsh-chat-clock.git
cd dsh-chat-clock
bash install.sh

notes.zh: 纯样式型客户端插件，不改 DSH 源码；每个思考/工具调用的独立时间仍需核心改动。
notes.en: Style-only client plugin, no DSH core changes; per-step timestamps still need a core change.

plugins.name: dsh-workspace-status

description.zh: 在输入框下方的 composer dock 显示当前仓库的分支、暂存/未暂存/未跟踪/冲突数量、ahead/behind，以及 GitHub PR 状态，点击可直接打开 PR。
description.en: A composer-dock pill showing the current repo's branch, staged/unstaged/untracked/conflicted counts, ahead/behind, and the GitHub PR status (click to open).

plugins.install:
git clone git@github.com:martinx/dsh-workspace-status.git
cd dsh-workspace-status
bash install.sh

notes.zh: 需要本机有 git；PR 状态需要 gh 已登录；非 git 目录自动隐藏；15 秒轮询。
notes.en: Requires git; PR status requires an authenticated gh; hidden outside git repos; polls every 15s.
